name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Steamed Pork & Scallion Gyoza Dumplings (No Chili Mod)
whyItWorks: Steamed gyoza are much easier to digest than deep-fried or pan-charred dumplings. The minced pork filling is tender and easy to break down.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order gyoza steamed (not fried) with mild soy dipping sauce (hold chili oil).
